definition: Retatrutide + Tirzepatide Blend (20 mg + 40 mg) (RTTR) is a multi-component peptide blend supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 60 mg. faq.question: How is Retatrutide + Tirzepatide Blend (20 mg + 40 mg) tested for purity and identity?

Results are reported per lot, not as a catalogue average.
